players.product: bring-your-own-power combined-cycle gas generation for hyperscale data centers (1.2 GW Texas project; 5.4 GW of GE Vernova turbine / Kiewit EPC slots)

quarterly_data.signal: NRG's 10-K states that on February 13, 2025 NRG signed a strategic Project Development Agreement with GE Vernova (GEV) and Kiewit's subsidiary TIC to develop and construct up to 5.4 GW of new gas-fired, combined cycle generation projects, to be owned and operated by NRG, and entered into slot reservation agreements with GEV for the procurement of 3.6 GW of 7HA gas turbines; the first projects under this development agreement are expected to commence operations by the end of 2029.
quarterly_data.figure: slot reservation agreements with GE Vernova for 3.6 GW of 7HA gas turbines; Project Development Agreement (February 13, 2025) for up to 5.4 GW of combined cycle generation; first projects by end of 2029
